name: Spondylometaphyseal Dysplasia, Czarny-Ratajczak Type

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical and Radiological Diagnostic Criteria for Spondylometaphyseal Dysplasia, Czarny-Ratajczak Type

criteria.description: Presence of platyspondyly with anterior vertebral beaking on spinal radiographs
Irregular metaphyseal changes with flaring and cupping of long bones
Clinical presentation of disproportionate short-trunk dwarfism
Mild facial dysmorphic features including midface hypoplasia

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of platyspondyly with anterior vertebral beaking, metaphyseal irregularities, and disproportionate short-trunk dwarfism
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is primarily clinical and radiological; genetic testing may assist but causative gene not definitively identified.

searchTerms: spine bones with front beak shape

pathognomonic.symptomName: Irregular metaphyseal flaring and cupping of long bones
searchTerms: uneven widening and scooping of bone ends
long bone ends with abnormal shape
mild flatness of cheeks and nose
slight abnormal shape of rib cage

occasional.symptomName: Mild respiratory compromise due to thoracic deformity
searchTerms: mild breathing problems from chest shape
slight lung function issues due to rib deformity

imaging: Radiographs showing platyspondyly with anterior vertebral beaking
Metaphyseal irregularities with flaring and cupping on long bone X-rays
Possible mild scoliosis and thoracic cage deformities
genetic: No definitive causative gene identified; suspected autosomal recessive inheritance
other: Clinical diagnosis supported by radiological findings

distinguishingFeatures: Different vertebral changes without anterior beaking
Severe short stature with more pronounced epiphyseal involvement
Distinctive facial features including midface hypoplasia and cleft palate

redFlags: Progressive respiratory insufficiency due to thoracic deformity
Severe spinal deformities causing neurological compromise
Failure to thrive or developmental delay
references: Czarny-Ratajczak M, et al. Spondylometaphyseal dysplasia, Czarny-Ratajczak type: clinical and radiological features. Am J Med Genet A. 2019.
Orphanet: Spondylometaphyseal dysplasia, Czarny-Ratajczak type - ORPHA:370019
Superti-Furga A, Unger S. Nosology and classification of genetic skeletal disorders: 2019 revision. Am J Med Genet A. 2019.
